mapper.sql: task.id AS id, detail.scope_type AS scope_type, detail.scope_id AS scope_id, task.operation AS operation, task.status AS status, detail.scanned_count AS scanned_count, detail.parsed_count AS parsed_count, detail.skipped_count AS skipped_count, detail.failed_count AS failed_count, detail.indexed_document_count AS indexed_document_count, detail.indexed_chunk_count AS indexed_chunk_count, detail.failed_document_count AS failed_document_count, detail.failures_json AS failures_json, task.step AS phase, task.progress_current AS progress_current, task.progress_total AS progress_total, task.current_item AS current_item, task.queued_at AS queued_at, task.started_at AS started_at, task.completed_at AS completed_at, task.duration_ms AS duration_ms, task.error_message AS error_message, detail.error_stage AS error_stage, task.error_code AS error_code, detail.error_detail AS error_detail, task.created_at AS created_at, task.updated_at AS updated_at, task.attempt AS attempt, task.max_attempts AS max_attempts, task.resumable AS resumable, task.retry_of_run_id AS retry_of_run_id, task.available_at AS available_at
FROM durable_task_runs task JOIN knowledge_folder_runs detail ON detail.id = task.id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE detail.scope_type = #{scopeType} AND ((#{scopeId} IS NULL AND detail.scope_id IS NULL) OR detail.scope_id = #{scopeId}) AND task.operation = #{operation} AND task.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'RETRY_WAIT', 'CANCELLING') ORDER BY task.created_at ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT
WHERE task.status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') ORDER BY task.started_at ASC, task.created_at ASC

SELECT
WHERE task.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY_WAIT') ORDER BY task.available_at ASC, task.queued_at ASC, task.created_at ASC

SELECT
WHERE task.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'RETRY_WAIT', 'CANCELLING') ORDER BY CASE task.status WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN 0 WHEN 'CANCELLING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(task.started_at, task.available_at, task.queued_at) ASC

SELECT
WHERE (#{scopeType} IS NULL OR detail.scope_type = #{scopeType}) AND (#{scopeId} IS NULL OR detail.scope_id = #{scopeId}) ORDER BY task.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1)
LEFT JOIN knowledge_folders folder ON detail.scope_type = 'KNOWLEDGE_FOLDER' AND folder.id = detail.scope_id

SELECT
WHERE task.created_at = ( SELECT MAX(inner_task.created_at) FROM durable_task_runs inner_task JOIN knowledge_folder_runs inner_detail ON inner_detail.id = inner_task.id WHERE inner_detail.scope_type = detail.scope_type AND ((inner_detail.scope_id IS NULL AND detail.scope_id IS NULL) OR inner_detail.scope_id = detail.scope_id) ) ORDER BY task.created_at DESC

SELECT
ORDER BY task.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_folder_runs SET scanned_count = #{scannedCount}, parsed_count = #{parsedCount}, skipped_count = #{skippedCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, indexed_document_count = #{indexedDocumentCount}, indexed_chunk_count = #{indexedChunkCount}, failed_document_count = #{failedDocumentCount}, failures_json = #{failuresJson}, error_stage = NULL, error_detail = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
